title: A domain's glossary
description: docs/glossary.yaml in a domain folder: the ubiquitous language — one entry per term, and what in the model it names (ADR 0016).

term.description: The word the domain uses, as it writes it (Sample, Route).

definition.description: What it means, in a sentence or two — in the domain's words, not the model's.

aka.description: Other words in use for the same thing, and abbreviations.

avoid.description: Words not to use for it, each with why — a word that means something else here, or a framework's word for a business thing.

model.description: What it names in the model: a type (Sample), an event (StabilityExpired) or a state (Type.path.to.state). Checked against the model.
